title: <repo>/.agentic-workflow/deploy.json
description: How /landAndDeploy deploys and checks a release. Read by skills/landAndDeploy. The skill runs command and smokeTests as shell, so the file stays untracked.

command.description: Shell command that deploys. Streamed to stdout.

healthUrl.description: URL polled after deploy; expects 200 OK.

timeout.description: Seconds, for both the deploy command and health polling (default 600).

journey.description: When present, the deployed app is driven after the smoke tests through /verify-app.
